tour.welcomeBody: Seen smoke, dust or a burning pile? Report it in under a minute, and the official responsible for that area is told. Here's how.
tour.photoBody: Take a photo of what you see, or choose one you already took. The clearer, the better.
tour.voiceBody: Add a short voice note in your own language: what's burning, how long it's been going.
tour.locationBody: Your location tells us whose area it is. If GPS is off, tap Change and type it in.
tour.sendBody: In a few seconds you'll see what we found and advice to stay safe, which you can also listen to.
tour.reportsBody: Every report you send is here, with its result and anything officials ask you.
tour.helpBody: Tap this button any time to replay the guide.
